senses.gloss: m. pl. (= מִשְׁנִיִּים, denom. of מִשְׁנָה) teachers of Mishnah. Lam. R. introd. (R. Abba 2); Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ, a. e. סופרים ומ׳ teachers of Bible and of Mishnah.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 47">Ex. R. s. 47</cite> <he>שיהיו המ׳ יושבין וכ׳</he> that the teachers of Mishnah should hold sessions in the morning &c.; a. e.
